title.tagline: Dig deep, build a home, and open the gate to the next world.
title.continueUnavailable: No saved game in this browser yet
title.continueTip: Carry on from the last save: day {day}, {dwarves} dwarves, world {seed}
newWorld.title: New world
newWorld.seedHint: The same seed always makes the same world, so you can share one with a friend.
newWorld.campaignNote: You start in the forest. Each World Gate a colony builds opens another biome (to try one early, add ?biome=snow to the page address).
newWorld.locked: Build a World Gate to open this biome
loading.title: Forging a new world
loading.terrain: Raising hills and laying down rock
loading.ores: Threading ore veins through the stone
menu.title: Paused
menu.saveTip: Save now. The game also saves by itself every dawn; Continue on the title screen picks up the latest save.
lost.title: The colony has fallen
lost.text: Every dwarf is gone, and nobody is left to bring them back.
won.title: The World Gate is open
won.text: On day {day} the last runestone was set and the gate woke. Beyond it lies a new world: up to three dwarves can step through and start again there, keeping what they know and what they carry.
won.unlocked: A new biome is open to you: {biome}.
won.hint: The new world takes this one's place in your save slot when it first saves (at its first dawn, or when you save).
hud.researchDone: Every tier of the tech tree reached
hud.waveWarningTip: A portal opens to the {side} at nightfall. Get the dwarves armed and the doors shut.
hud.waveOpenTip: Invaders still to come through or be beaten. At dawn the portal takes them back.
hud.hint: Move: {keys}, screen edges or middle-drag · Zoom: wheel · Pause: Space · Hover the tools for help
hud.minimap: Map ({key}) — click to move the camera
hover.unexploredDetail: Light, or a dwarf passing close by, will show what's here
hover.hearthDetail: Your colony's home: dwarves store and fetch goods here
hover.portalOpen: Invaders come through it until dawn
hover.trap: Stabs any creature that steps on it
hover.turret: Shoots monsters up to {range} tiles away
dig.supports-hearth: This ground holds up the Hearth
dig.supports-tree: A tree grows on it: fell the tree first
dig.supports-furniture: Furniture stands on this: take it apart first
settings.title: Settings
settings.edgePan: Pan the camera when the mouse touches a screen edge
settings.rebindHint: Click a key to change it, then press the new key. Esc cancels.
settings.reservedKey: {key} is reserved by the browser. Choose another key.
storage.blocked: This browser is blocking storage (private browsing can do this), so settings and saved games won't be kept after you close the tab.
toast.pausedHidden: Paused while the tab was in the background. Press {key} to resume.
fatal.title: The game can't start
fatal.webgl: Gatewright needs WebGL, which this browser or device isn't providing. Try a current version of Chrome, Firefox, Edge or Safari, and check that hardware acceleration is turned on in the browser settings.
fatal.boot: Something went wrong while starting the game: {message}
debug.title: Debug
mark.noSeeds: Waiting for {item}: there are none in storage
mark.missing: Waiting for {item}: there's none in storage
mark.support: Waiting for what will hold it up to be built first
mark.blocked: No dwarf can reach this and get back safely
mark.unsafe: Digging this would leave a dwarf stuck in a hole: dig a way out first
mark.unsafeBuild: Building this would shut a dwarf in: clear a way out first
tool.auto.tip: Mark whatever you click: blocks to dig, trees to fell, plants to pick, animals to hunt, furniture to take apart, fallen dwarves to revive. Click a mark again to remove it; click a dwarf to select it ({key})
tool.auto.dig: Click or drag to mark for digging
tool.auto.chop: Click to mark this tree for felling
tool.auto.hunt: Click to mark this animal for hunting
tool.auto.unhunt: Click to call off the hunt
tool.auto.revive: Click to bring them back with a rekindling draught
tool.auto.reviveNone: Click to bring them back: it takes a rekindling draught, and there's none in storage
tool.auto.unrevive: Click to call off the revival
tool.auto.lost: Lost in the lava: nothing can bring them back
tool.auto.monster: Dwarves fight monsters by themselves when they come near
tool.auto.unfarm: Click to stop farming this plot
tool.select.tip: Select a dwarf to see its details ({key})
tool.dig.tip: Mark blocks for your dwarves to dig: click or drag over them ({key})
tool.dig.hint: Click or drag to mark for digging
tool.chop.tip: Mark trees for your dwarves to fell: click any part of a tree ({key})
tool.chop.hint: Click to mark this tree for felling
tool.build.tip: Plan blocks, ladders and doors: pick one, then click or drag. Dwarves fetch the materials from storage ({key})
tool.build.hint: Click or drag to build here
tool.wall.tip: Plan background walls, which dwarves can climb: pick a material, then click or drag ({key})
tool.wall.hint: Click or drag to put up a wall here
tool.furniture.tip: Set down chests, torches, crafting stations and more: pick one, then click where it should stand ({key})
tool.furniture.hint: Click to set it down here
tool.farm.tip: Mark farm plots: pick a crop, then click or drag along open ground over dirt. Dwarves till the soil, sow, and bring in each harvest, again and again. Crops need light to grow ({key})
tool.farm.hint: Click or drag to farm {crop} here
tool.farm.noSeeds: No seeds in storage: plots wait to be sown
tool.palette.none: None in storage: dwarves will wait for it
build.unsupported: Nothing would hold it up: build beside a block, a ladder or a wall
build.needs-floor: It needs solid ground under it
build.needs-wall: It hangs on a wall: put a background wall behind it, or a block beside it
tool.cancel.tip: Remove planned work (digging, felling, building): click or drag over it ({key})
tool.cancel.hint: Click or drag to remove the plan
tool.cancel.farm: Click or drag to stop farming here (a seed in the ground comes back)
tool.priority.tip: Change which marked work gets done first: pick a level, then click or drag over marks ({key})
tool.priority.hint: Click or drag to make it {priority}
tool.priority.level: New marks and the Priority tool use this level
toolbar.label: Tools
activity.stranded: Stuck: can't find a way home
activity.toFloor: Going to sleep by the Hearth
activity.toTill: Going to till a farm plot
activity.retreating: Badly hurt: falling back to the Hearth
activity.deadRevivable: Fallen: a rekindling draught can bring them back
colony.storageFull: Full: items wait on the ground. Build chests for more room.
colony.toggleStorage: Show or hide the stored goods ({key})
crafting.title: Crafting
crafting.locked: {count} more recipes unlock as the colony climbs the tech tree ({key}).
crafting.queueEmpty: Nothing queued yet: pick a recipe above.
dwarf.combat: Fights with {weapon}: {damage} damage a blow · Armour {armor}
need.slow: Works slower when hungry or tired; wounded dwarves stay out of fights and mend by the Hearth.
slot.head: Head
toast.reviveHint: A rekindling draught can bring them back: click them with Auto.
toast.retreating: {name} is badly hurt and falls back to the Hearth.
toast.nightThreat: Creatures of the dark are stirring near the colony. Light keeps them away; doors keep them out.
toast.waveWarning: An invasion is coming! A portal will open to the {side} at nightfall.
toast.waveStarted: The portal is open: {size} invaders are coming!
toast.waveRetreat: Dawn: the portal draws the last invaders back through.
toast.jobBlocked: Some planned work can't be reached safely. It shows a red mark: dig or build a way to it.
toast.storageFull: Storage is full: dug-up goods wait on the ground. Build chests for more room.
toast.tierReached: Tech tree: {tier} reached! New recipes are ready to craft.
toast.tierDwarves: Tech tree: {tier} reached! New recipes are ready, and {count} more dwarves are coming to join the colony.
toast.tierDwarf: Tech tree: {tier} reached! New recipes are ready, and a new dwarf is coming to join the colony.
toast.dwarfArrived: {name} has come to the Hearth to join the colony.
toast.cropRipe: {crop} is ripe and ready to pick.
toast.loadFailed: The saved game couldn't be loaded: {message}
toast.travellers: {names} stepped through the World Gate into a new world.
toast.night: Night falls on day {day}. Tired dwarves head for bed.
toast.starving: {name} is starving! Put some food in storage: berries, mushrooms, bread...
toast.collapsed: {name} collapsed from exhaustion and fell asleep on the spot.
debug.jobsValue: {dig} dig · {chop} fell · {farm} farm · {build} build · {craft} craft · {haul} haul · {fight} fight · {blocked} blocked
build.needs-soil: Crops need soil under them: dirt or clay
hover.plotUntilled: Farm plot for {crop}: waiting to be tilled
hover.plotEmpty: Farm plot for {crop}: waiting to be sown
hover.plotDark: {percent}% grown, but too dark here to grow: crops need sunlight or a torch nearby
hover.plotRipe: Ripe: a dwarf will pick it
tech.title: Tech tree
tech.intro: Making something for the first time earns research. Fill a tier's bar to unlock the next tier's recipes; some tiers bring new dwarves.
tech.complete: Every tier reached. Build the World Gate to win this world.
tech.notMade: {item}: not made yet (+{points} research the first time)
error.saveVersionNewer: it was made by a newer version of the game
error.saveVersionOlder: it was made by an older version of the game that this one can't read
error.storageBlocked: this browser isn't letting the game store data
